是啊，为了和他的爱好一样，我天天看球赛。 (Shì a, wèile hé tā de àihào yíyàng, wǒ tiāntiān kàn qiúsài.) - Yes, to share the same hobby as him, I watch ball games every day.

Lesson 19 Texts: 你没看出来吗 (Didn't You Recognize Him?)
他是小刚啊。 (Tā shì Xiǎogāng a.) - It's Xiaogang.
怎么看上去跟现在不太一样？ (Zěnme kàn shangqu gēn xiànzài bú tài yíyàng?) - Why does he look not quite the same as now?
他上班穿西服、衬衫，比赛的时候穿的是运动服。 (Tā shàng bān chuān xīfú, chènshān, bǐsài de shíhou chuān de shì yùndòngfú.) - He wears a suit and shirt to work, and wore sportswear during the competition.

他今天穿蓝西服，看上去像40多岁，还是穿运动服让他更年轻。 (Tā jīntiān chuān lán xīfú, kàn shangqu xiàng sìshí duō suì, háishi chuān yùndòngfú ràng tā gèng niánqīng.) - Today he is wearing a blue suit and looks about 40; wearing sportswear still makes him look younger.
我们一年没见面了吧？ (Wǒmen yì nián méi jiàn miàn le ba?) - We haven't seen each other for a year, have we?
听说你都有女儿了？ (Tīngshuō nǐ dōu yǒu nǚ'ér le?) - I heard you even have a daughter now?
她多大了？ (Tā duō dà le?) - How old is she?
她去年秋天出生的，刚过完一岁生日。 (Tā qùnián qiūtiān chūshēng de, gāng guòwán yí suì shēngrì.) - She was born last autumn and has just had her first birthday.
她喜欢什么？我送给她。 (Tā xǐhuan shénme? Wǒ sònggěi tā.) - What does she like? I'll give it to her.
她就喜欢听她爸爸学鸟叫。 (Tā jiù xǐhuan tīng tā bàba xué niǎo jiào.) - She just likes listening to her dad imitating birds.
哭的时候，只要他爸爸学小鸟叫，她马上就安静下来了。 (Kū de shíhou, zhǐyào tā bàba xué xiǎo niǎo jiào, tā mǎshàng jiù ānjìng xialai le.) - When she cries, as long as her dad imitates a little bird, she quiets down immediately.
啊？这个礼物我没办法送。 (Á? Zhège lǐwù wǒ méi bànfǎ sòng.) - Huh? I can't give this gift.

Dialogue: 在公司 (In the Company)
时间过得真快，新的一年快要到了！ (Shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài, xīn de yì nián kuàiyào dào le!) - How time flies! The New Year is approaching!
是啊，谢谢大家这一年对我的帮助！ (Shì a, xièxie dàjiā zhè yì nián duì wǒ de bāngzhù!) - Yes. Thank you all for your help during the past year.
希望我们的公司明年更好！ (Xīwàng wǒmen de gōngsī míngnián gèng hǎo!) - I hope our company will become even better in the next year.

只有你们的爸爸妈妈才能分出来哪个是哥哥，哪个是弟弟吧。 (Zhǐyǒu nǐmen de bàba māma cái néng fēn chulai nǎge shì gēge, nǎge shì dìdi ba.) - Only your parents can tell which one is the older brother and which one is the younger brother.

只有……才…… (zhǐyǒu……cái……) - only… (that/can…)

有些问题看上去很难，但是做起来非常简单，所以得试着做做。 (Yǒuxiē wèntí kàn shangqu hěn nán, dànshì zuò qilai fēicháng jiǎndān, suǒyǐ děi shìzhe zuòzuo.) - Some problems look very difficult but are very simple to actually do, so you have to try doing them.
所以只有真正做事情的时候，才能了解有多难。 (Suǒyǐ zhǐyǒu zhēnzhèng zuò shìqing de shíhou, cái néng liǎojiě yǒu duō nán.) - So only when you really do things can you understand how difficult they are.

Dialogue: 在家里 (Whose room is this)
这是谁的房间？ (Zhè shì shéi de fángjiān?) - Whose room is this?
这是我和我丈夫的，旁边那个小的房间是我女儿的。 (Zhè shì wǒ hé wǒ zhàngfu de, pángbiān nàge xiǎo de fángjiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér de.) - It's my husband's and mine. The small one beside it is my daughter's.
你女儿的房间真漂亮！ (Nǐ nǚ'ér de fángjiān zhēn piàoliang!) - Your daughter's room is so pretty!
都是粉色的。 (Dōu shì fěnsè de.) - It's all pink.
是啊，粉色是我女儿最喜欢的颜色。 (Shì a, fěnsè shì wǒ nǚ'ér zuì xǐhuan de yánsè.) - Yes. Pink is her favorite color.
你看见我的杯子了吗？ (Nǐ kànjiàn wǒ de bēizi le ma?) - Have you seen my cup?
这里有几个杯子，哪个是你的？ (Zhèli yǒu jǐ ge bēizi, nǎge shì nǐ de?) - Here are a few cups. Which one is yours?
左边那个红色的是我的。 (Zuǒbian nàge hóngsè de shì wǒ de.) - The red one on the left is mine.

Dialogue 4: 在休息室 (In the lounge)
桌子上放着很多饮料，你喝什么？ (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào, nǐ hē shénme?) - There are lots of drinks on the table; what will you have?
茶或者咖啡都可以。 (Chá huòzhě kāfēi dōu kěyǐ.) - Tea or coffee, either is fine.
你呢？你喝什么？ (Nǐ ne? Nǐ hē shénme?) - And you? What will you drink?
我喝茶，茶是我的最爱。 (Wǒ hē chá, chá shì wǒ de zuì ài.) - I'll drink tea; tea is my favourite.

天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶会很舒服。 (Tiān lěngle huòzhě gōngzuò lèile de shíhou, hē bēi rè chá huì hěn shūfu.) - When the weather turns cold or when work has made me tired, a cup of hot tea feels very comfortable.
你喜欢喝什么茶？ (Nǐ xǐhuan hē shénme chá?) - What kind of tea do you like to drink?
花茶、绿茶、红茶，我都喜欢。 (Huāchá, lǜchá, hóngchá, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.) - Flower tea, green tea, black tea - I like them all.

Lesson 15: 我是坐飞机来的 (I Came by Plane)
你们是怎么来饭店的？ (Nǐmen shì zěnme lái fàndiàn de?) - How did you come here?
我们是坐出租车来的。 (Wǒmen shì zuò chūzūchē lái de.) - We came by taxi.
他是和朋友一起开车来的。 (Tā shì hé péngyou yìqǐ kāi chē lái de.) - He drove here with his friend.
听张先生说，您是坐飞机来北京的？ (Tīng Zhāng xiānsheng shuō, nín shì zuò fēijī lái Běijīng de?) - Mr. Zhang said you came to Beijing by plane, didn't you?
是的。 (Shì de.) - Yes, I did.
一起 (yìqǐ) - together
Grammar: 是……的 structure (emphasize time/place/manner)
Grammar: 不是……的 (negative form of 是……的; 不 goes before 是, and 是 cannot be omitted in negative sentences)
Grammar: omitting 是 in 是……的 (是 can be omitted in positive and interrogative sentences, but not in negative sentences)
我是昨天来的。 (Wǒ shì zuótiān lái de.) - I came yesterday.
这是在北京买的。 (Zhè shì zài Běijīng mǎi de.) - This was bought in Beijing.

椅子 (yǐzi) - chair
Dialogue: 在家里 (At Home) - Buying New Chairs
我们要不要买几个新的椅子？ (Wǒmen yào bu yào mǎi jǐ ge xīn de yǐzi?) - Don't you think we should buy some new chairs?
六个多月。 (Liù ge duō yuè.) - More than six months.
好啊。 (Hǎo a.) - Yes.
什么时候去买？ (Shénme shíhou qù mǎi?) - When shall we go to buy them?
明天下午怎么样？ (Míngtiān xiàwǔ zěnmeyàng?) - What about tomorrow afternoon?
你明天几点能回来？ (Nǐ míngtiān jǐ diǎn néng huílai?) - When will you be back tomorrow?
三点多。 (Sān diǎn duō.) - A little bit later after three o'clock.
新 (xīn) - new
要 (yào) - aux. to want to
Grammar: 几 + measure word + noun (几 indicates an indefinite number less than 10, e.g. 几个人, 几本书)
Grammar: Approximate Numbers 几 and 多
Grammar: The Auxiliary Verb 要
Grammar: Negative form of the auxiliary verb 要 is usually 不想 (e.g. 小王要去，我不想去)

Text 2: 在朋友家 At a friend's home [audio 12-2]

再来点儿米饭吧，你吃得太少了。 (Zài lái diǎnr mǐfàn ba, nǐ chī de tài shǎo le.) - Have more rice, please. You ate too little.
不少了，今天吃得很好，太谢谢你了。 (Bù shǎo le, jīntiān chī de hěn hǎo, tài xièxie nǐ le.) - Not a little actually. I've enjoyed the meal a lot. Thank you so much.

Dialogue 2: 在打电话 (On the phone)
周 Zhōu (surname)
周明 Zhōu Míng (name of a person)
他出去办事了，下午回来。 (Tā chūqu bàn shì le, xiàwǔ huílai.) - He has gone out on business and will be back in the afternoon.
回来了就让他给我打个电话。 (Huílai le jiù ràng tā gěi wǒ dǎ ge diànhuà.) - As soon as he is back, have him give me a call.
好的，他到了办公室我就告诉他。 (Hǎo de, tā dàole bàngōngshì wǒ jiù gàosu tā.) - OK, as soon as he gets to the office I will tell him.
喂，你好，请问周明在吗？ (Wèi, nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn Zhōu Míng zài ma?) - Hello, may I ask whether Zhou Ming is in?
周经理出去了，不在办公室。 (Zhōu jīnglǐ chūqu le, bú zài bàngōngshì.) - Manager Zhou has gone out; he is not in the office.
他去哪儿了？ (Tā qù nǎr le?) - Where has he gone?
